lessons_retained: LSM amplification triangle (read/write/space) governs engine choice by workload shape
column families: one engine, per-keyspace compaction/retention regimes
FIFO-for-monotonic-workloads: match retention style to key arrival shape, then revisit
embedded library vs server: no network hop, but replication/backup/tooling are YOURS to build
row point-lookup engines are wrong for analytical scans (Helius moved ClickHouse->RocksDB for lookups; the reverse holds too)
lessons_declined_for_now: RocksDB itself: no write-throughput workload in CYNIC justifies an LSM engine yet; SurrealDB already embeds its own storage; adopting a second raw KV engine adds ops surface without a matching workload

data_kinds.integrity: reproducible from K3+K2; digest of inputs recorded

mapping_rules.one_kind_one_home: every datum maps to exactly one kind and therefore one layer/engine/retention story
mapping_rules.contracts_are_git: K6 lives in git — never duplicated into a database; DBs may CACHE a contract but git remains authority (AGENTS.md authority order)
mapping_rules.secrets_never_stored: K8 placement follows AGENTS.md secret classes; storage planes must refuse them at schema level
mapping_rules.distillation_direction: K3 -> mine -> K4 -> sign -> K1. Raw stays until distillation sign-off per vein

rocksdb_patterns_applied.per_keyspace_regimes: like Solana's Blockstore column families: L0 tables get 'never compact away' semantics; L2 hot/warm tiers get FIFO-like age eviction AFTER distillation sign-off (our equivalent of matching retention style to workload shape)
rocksdb_patterns_applied.monotonic_keys: PoH timestamps and model lineage are monotonic like validator slots: range scans ordered by time are the primary access path — keep keys sortable, avoid random-key layouts for evidence
rocksdb_patterns_applied.amplification_awareness: recomputing K4 from K3 repeatedly = read amplification of mining; cache distilled models (that IS the GC), but record input digests so recompute stays possible
rocksdb_patterns_applied.embedded_not_server: keep single-writer planes embedded (sqlite/files); only L0/L1 justify a server process today

open_decisions.question: L0 cold evidence home: surrealdb SCHEMAFULL table vs append-only signed journal file per node?
open_decisions.leaning: journal file: PoH anchors integrity, file needs no server, replication = rsync of signed bytes

open_decisions.leaning: bounded root executor job, nightly, digest-only first pass
